title: [华仔的Vulkan汉化]Huazai's Vulkan localization
description: The Chinese translation of the Vulkan mod is not yet complete. However, I have finished it this time.
body: Vulkan is a highly detailed mod, but the language author has not yet completed the refinement. I have created a Chinese package to make Vulkan more understandable and enable Chinese Minecraft players to widely utilize Vulkan.
